title: Middle East live: Vance heads to Pakistan for Iran talks as Israeli assault on Lebanon tests truce
summary: US Vice President JD Vance sets off Friday for Pakistan to lead mediated talks with Iran in a bid to find a resolution to the war as massive Israeli strikes on Lebanon this week tested a fragile US-Iran ceasefire.
